Mod.name: Toilet Flush Spell
Mod.description: Lob a porcelain throne at your enemies! The toilet lands as a real physics object, sucks nearby enemies into the bowl, swirls them around, and flushes the small ones straight down the pipes (proper deaths, gold and all). Big enemies clog it, take damage, and get spat back out. Every successful flush makes the toilet hungrier - feed it minions until THE PORCELAIN THRONE can swallow anything. Find the spell in chests, shops and wands. Rumor speaks of a secret code that summons the legendary Flusher 3000...
